description: Create an offer for a chosen seller (POST /v1/jobs): a job id, priced terms and the UNSIGNED calls that fund it — the hirer signs them in their own wallet; nothing is signed or sent here. body is the /v1/jobs request body (e.g. { chainId: 36927, seller, price_usdc, class, handshake_id }). Naming handshake_id needs the api_key that opened the handshake.
name: taifoon_hire
